question: Does the frozen full-ecology AGI Candidate remove the remaining supported-count strategy and winning-path defects when combined with the previously frozen Trust Governor and Capacity Operator under unchanged physical rules?

selectionRule.balance: Select only if every three-, four-, and five-player faction, seat, profile, diversity, fallback, and forced-no-op bound passes with no credible homogeneous, pairwise, or diagnostic dominance.
selectionRule.measuredDefects: The three-, four-, and five-player profile ranges and five-player winning-path entropy must all pass. AGI Candidate must no longer produce the prior 33 to 42 percent supported-count win shares.
selectionRule.trustIdentity: Trust Governor must average at least one Influence selection per appearance, keep Influence below its largest Core Action, reach Trust 4 in at least 85 percent of appearances, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.capacityIdentity: Capacity Operator must average at least two Build selections per appearance, select Research plus Deploy more often than Build, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.agiIdentity: AGI Candidate must be the largest profile contributor to AGI-declaration winner credit, supply at least 30 percent of that credit overall, retain mean Mandate of at least 14, and keep Dossier as its highest Program weight.
selectionRule.rulesBoundary: Only the frozen AGI policy differs from the corrected v2 ecology. Physical rules, faction starts, Core Actions, scoring, and component supply remain canonical.
selectionRule.failure: Any failed supported-count bound, credible dominance, or identity check rejects profile promotion. Do not adaptively retrain. Name the residual failing profile, path, or mechanism and preregister one separate intervention if the evidence implicates it.

requiredDiagnostics: profile Action selections and Mandate sources
profile and faction win shares by supported player count
AGI emergence and winner override rates
